name: Unfinished Portrait
source:
You're an artist, alone in a dusty old studio. It's late, and you're tired. But you can't sleep just yet. You need to finish this last portrait, before it's too late.

[From [url=https://dondonpatapon.itch.io/unfinished-portrait]itch.io[/url]]
